usedFor: ThriveCart takes your checkouts, and Sendly saves each buyer when “Upsell Purchased” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Upsell Purchased” in ThriveCart, then “Create or Update Contact” in Sendly
bestTemplate.why: A customer who buys an upsell is stored in Sendly by phone number, updated if it already exists.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” keys on a phone number, so check the ThriveCart purchase supplies one.
